reason: This resistor only ties the tail node (net5) to VSS; if net5 is already intended to be at VSS (or you replace it with an ideal connection), the amplifier’s basic differential-pair behavior remains. impact_estimate: Low if net5 is otherwise fixed to VSS (e.g., direct short or current source); high if R0 is the only tail bias/return path.
